title: PM-VBRY Enrolment Update: Women Account for 28.56% of 9.99 Million First-Time Employees
summary: PM Viksit Bharat Rozgar Yojana enrolled 9.99M first-time employees (2.85M women = 28.56%). Maharashtra led registrations.

blocks.content: PM Viksit Bharat Rozgar Yojana enrolled 9.99M first-time employees (2.85M women = 28.56%). Maharashtra led registrations.

items: **Enrolment Stats:** Of 9.99M first-time workers, **2.85 million were women (28.56%)** vs 7.14M men.
**Scheme Outlay:** Implemented Aug 1, 2025 to July 31, 2027 with **₹99,446 crore** outlay.
